author: Milan Hrdlicka
text: Milan has measured the Ellbach bridge twice a year since 2011. We asked why the job is still done by hand.
quote_text: The bridge moves 4 millimetres between February and August, every year I have measured it. If I stop going out there myself, that becomes a number somebody downloaded. Then one August it is 9 millimetres, and nobody knows when it started.
